records.name: Jaipur Engineering College & Research Center, jaipur
records.statutory_basis: AICTE-approved private engineering college affiliated with Rajasthan Technical University
records.evidence: The official JECRC Foundation site identifies Jaipur Engineering College and Research Centre as an engineering college; the supplied institutional description identifies AICTE approval and RTU affiliation, placing it among private affiliated engineering colleges.

records.name: JECRC University
records.evidence: The official JECRC University site identifies the institution as JECRC University, established under the JECRC University Act, with degree admissions; it is therefore a Rajasthan state private university.

records.name: Kanoria P G Mahila Mahavidyalaya, Jaipur
records.statutory_basis: private affiliated women's degree college affiliated with the University of Rajasthan
records.evidence: The official Kanoria College site presents a women’s degree college in Jaipur offering undergraduate and postgraduate programmes and affiliated with the University of Rajasthan; it is not a university itself.

records.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri Government College, Kotputli
records.evidence: The official Rajasthan Higher Education directory identifies Lal Bahadur Shastri Government College, Kotputli, as a government college offering Arts, Science and Commerce degree programmes.

records.name: The LNM Institute of Information Technology, Jaipur
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act
records.evidence: The official LNMIIT site identifies the institute as a deemed-to-be university with undergraduate and postgraduate admissions; its joint origin with the Government of Rajasthan does not make it a state public university.

records.name: Lucky Institute of Professional Studies
records.evidence: The official Lucky Institute site presents a trust-run institute offering degree and professional programmes through affiliation with Jai Narain Vyas University and Bikaner Technical University; it is a private affiliated college, not a university.

records.name: M.B.R. Government College, Balotra
records.evidence: The official Rajasthan Higher Education directory identifies M.B.R. Government College, Balotra, as a government postgraduate college with degree admissions.

records.name: Maharaja Ganga Singh Dental College & Research Centre
records.statutory_basis: private trust-run dental college recognised for BDS and MDS education
records.evidence: The official college site presents Maharaja Ganga Singh Dental College & Research Centre as a private dental college and research centre offering BDS and MDS programmes.

records.name: Maharishi Arvind Institute Of Science And Management
records.statutory_basis: private higher-education institute offering affiliated degree programmes
records.evidence: The official MAISM site presents a private institute offering management, computer science and commerce programmes; it is not listed as a university and is therefore classified as a private college/institute.

records.name: Mahatma Gandhi University of Medical Sciences & Technology, Jaipur
records.statutory_basis: Rajasthan state private medical university act
records.evidence: The official MGUMST site identifies Mahatma Gandhi University of Medical Sciences and Technology as a private university in Jaipur offering medicine, dentistry, nursing and allied-health degree programmes.
